_meta: REQ-9 AC9.2 (T12): the two WEB intent classes the engine must separate.
instant_lookup -> 'search' (one fast provider call); research -> 'crawler_query' (deep multi-page crawl).

Kept OUT of decision_engine_cases.json on purpose: that battery's _meta excludes internet-gated tools from its offline menu, and mixing the classes in would change its candidate sets (and therefore the BT-DEI-13 baseline).

Every case carries an explicit 'menu' so the two web tools are present and the rest of the menu is held constant across BOTH classes — the only thing that varies is intent, which is exactly what is being measured.
